source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A new mail tab has a chrome browser and a nested message pane. Waiting for the outer browser alone does not guarantee the inner message content is loaded. The intermittent browser_mailTabsAndWindows test added an explicit wait on secondOpenedMessagePane before checking currentURI.
title: Wait for the nested message pane before asserting its URI
